name: torii
title: Torii
text: The gate between the ordinary and the sacred. Two posts, two lintels, the one red thing.

name: fuji
title: Fuji
text: The mountain with snow on its shoulders and a red sun behind it. Drawn the way the woodblocks draw it: three strokes and a cap.

name: wave
title: The wave
text: Hokusai's claw, redrawn as three curls and a red sun. The foam is the field showing through.

name: koi
title: Koi
text: One carp, going up. The red patch on the head is the whole colour budget.

name: daruma
title: Daruma
text: Paint one eye when you set the goal, the other when you reach it. This one has one eye.

name: maneki
title: Maneki-neko
text: The beckoning cat, left paw up for customers. The collar is the red.

name: sakura
title: Sakura
text: Five petals, each notched once. The centre is red because the season is short.

name: momiji
title: Momiji
text: The maple leaf in autumn red, the one month Kyoto is unbearable to visit and everyone goes anyway.

name: bamboo
title: Take
text: Bamboo: three culms, the nodes marked, leaves at the top. It bends, it does not break, the proverb writes itself.

name: chochin
title: Chōchin
text: The paper lantern. Ribs drawn as arcs, a character left off on purpose so it can mean any shop.

name: kitsune
title: Kitsune
text: The fox mask from the festival stall. White face, red markings, ears that hear everything.

name: orizuru
title: Orizuru
text: The folded crane, drawn flat: two wings, a beak, a tail, and the creases that make it a crane and not a paper triangle.

name: bonsai
title: Bonsai
text: A pine in a shallow pot, forty years of patience in a shape that fits on a shelf.

name: pagoda
title: Pagoda
text: Five stories, each roof a little smaller, the finial the one red line. Wood, no nails.

name: sensu
title: Sensu
text: The folding fan, open. Nine ribs, a red field, the rivet at the bottom.

name: uchiwa
title: Uchiwa
text: The flat fan for summer festivals. Round, a handle, a red circle: the cheapest good design in Japan.

name: geta
title: Geta
text: Wooden sandals, two teeth each, the red thong. The sound of a summer street.

name: kimono
title: Kimono
text: The garment, hung flat as a T. The obi is the red band; the sleeves tell you it is a woman's.

name: obi
title: Obi knot
text: The taiko musubi, the drum knot on the back of a kimono. Drawn from behind, which is the only way to see it.

name: onigiri
title: Onigiri
text: Rice, a strip of nori, one umeboshi. Lunch, drawn in three shapes.

name: ramen
title: Ramen
text: A bowl with the red double line, noodles, two chopsticks, and steam. Drawn at 1 a.m.

name: chawan
title: Chawan
text: The tea bowl, with a kintsugi seam. The break is the red line; the repair is the point.

name: chasen
title: Chasen
text: The bamboo whisk, eighty tines from one piece of bamboo, and the matcha it is for.

name: sake
title: Tokkuri and ochoko
text: The flask and the cup. Warm in winter, cold in summer, the same drawing either way.

name: kokeshi
title: Kokeshi
text: The wooden doll from Tōhoku: a head, a body, no arms, and a red flower on the kimono.

name: kabuto
title: Kabuto
text: The samurai helmet with its crescent crest. Drawn front-on, the crest the only red.

name: katana
title: Katana
text: The sword, sheathed. A single curve, the guard, and the red cord on the grip.

name: kendama
title: Kendama
text: The cup-and-ball. Red ball, string, three cups. Harder than it looks, like most things here.

name: koinobori
title: Koinobori
text: Carp streamers for Children's Day, three on a pole, the red one for the mother.

name: tombo
title: Tombo
text: The dragonfly, the samurai's insect because it never flies backward. Four wings, a red body.

name: tsuki
title: Tsuki to usagi
text: The moon and the rabbit pounding mochi in it. Every child in Japan sees the rabbit; the west sees a face.

name: hanabi
title: Hanabi
text: Fireworks over the river. A chrysanthemum burst, red at the centre, and the trail it rode up on.

name: temari
title: Temari
text: The embroidered thread ball. Bands of red and teal over a paper sphere; a gift, never a toy.

name: ema
title: Ema
text: The wooden wish plaque from the shrine rack, the string through the hole, a red horse where the wish goes.

name: omamori
title: Omamori
text: The amulet in its brocade pouch, knotted with the red cord. Not opened, ever; that is the rule.

name: shishiodoshi
title: Shishi-odoshi
text: The bamboo tube in the garden that fills, tips, and knocks the rock. Meant to scare deer; keeps time instead.

name: ikebana
title: Ikebana
text: Three stems, heaven, earth and human, in a shallow dish. The red bloom is heaven.

name: noren
title: Noren
text: The split curtain over a shop door. Two panels, a red circle across the gap, the rod above.

name: shoji
title: Shōji
text: The paper screen, the grid of lath, and a red sun through the paper from the garden side.

name: taiko
title: Taiko
text: The drum, on its side, two bachi crossed above it. Loud enough to feel in the ribs.

name: shamisen
title: Shamisen
text: Three strings, a square body, a long neck, and the bachi that plays it. Red for the body's edge.

name: mizuhiki
title: Mizuhiki
text: The paper cord knot on a gift envelope: red and white, tied once, not meant to be untied.

name: hinomaru
title: Hinomaru
text: The sun on the field. The simplest flag there is, and the reason one red accent works in every badge above.

name: sushi
title: Nigiri
text: Two pieces: tuna and salmon, the rice underneath, the wasabi nobody sees.

name: furoshiki
title: Furoshiki
text: The wrapping cloth, tied over a box. The knot on top is the handle; the cloth is the gift's second gift.

name: ume
title: Ume
text: The plum blossom, five round petals, out in February when nothing else is. Red centre, as before.
